description: This header file defines utility functions, macros, and includes for testing the WAN Manager component, including setup/teardown functions, mode control, and JSON parsing. It appears to support testing and mocking functionalities rather than implementing core logic.

methods.name: test_wan_manager_setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment before each test, setting up necessary components.

methods.name: test_wan_manager_teardown
methods.description: Cleans up test environment after each test, releasing resources.

methods.name: remove_device_prefix
methods.description: Removes device-specific prefix from a string identifier.

methods.name: test_get_dm
methods.description: Retrieves a test double for the device manager.

methods.name: test_handle_events
methods.description: Processes test events related to WAN mode.

methods.name: read_json_from_file
methods.description: Reads a JSON object from the specified file.

methods.name: enable_wan_mode
methods.description: Enables WAN mode with specified mode string, expects a certain status.

methods.name: disable_wan_mode
methods.description: Disables WAN mode with specified mode string, expects a certain status.

methods.name: set_wan_mode
methods.description: Sets WAN mode to the specified string and checks for expected status.

methods.name: assert_active_wan_mode
methods.description: Asserts that the current active WAN mode matches the expected mode and status.
